about: Full mode's pinned allowlist of stand-in backends (loop/full/contract.mjs). A full-mode shard names a backend id, its kind and a stand-in id (tool-qa docs/INTERFACES.md, "Writecheck modes: the write-backend contract"); each is only a name to look up here. A stand-in is started only from the image pinned here by its multi-platform index digest, as a sandbox service on the run network, from the folder `dir` (standin.json: the command, the address, the credentials it is given, the env prefixes it answers to, the guard and fixture it seeds; seed.mjs, evidence.mjs: our own code, run in our helper image). `backends` maps each backend id this stand-in serves to its kind. `fidelity` is the stand-in map's word (tool-qa meta/data/stand-ins.json): real = the product itself, faithful = another implementation whose own semantics hold, partial or not_faithful = not enough for the backend-semantic requirements; only real and faithful may judge UPD-1/2, CONC-1/2/3, TGT-1/3, RES-1 and ATOM-2 (loop/full/results.mjs). Add or change a stand-in only by a reviewed commit, with its digest read from the registry.
